svg.title: Two bits, and nothing else
svg.desc: A strip of virtio feature bits 0 to 39. Only bit 5, the MAC address, and bit 32, VERSION_1, are agreed with the guest. Bit 30 is a vhost-user bookkeeping bit that never reaches the guest. The checksum bits 0 and 1 and the TSO, UFO and ECN offload bits 7 to 14 are refused. Asking for any of 13 offload features, or anything else not offered, makes the device refuse the connection.
svg.text: Only bits 5 and 32 are set. The guest sends every frame complete and already checksummed.
Ask for any of 13 offload features, or anything else not offered, and the device refuses the connection.
